data.close_reason: Faulty premise, measured: a pass failing mid-apply (mid-pass reclaim refusal or any exception) loses no inbound import and duplicates no Jira mutation. Inbound applies before outbound, so the failed pass makes no outbound Jira write. The binding walk's level-triggered ADOPT arm replays an orphaned import on the next pass (one CREATE, no create_issue, one identity label), and above the blast-radius cap the breaker holds it, logs binding_walk_breaker_refused, and releases it later. Proven by tests/integration/reconciler/test_inbound_import_replayed_after_failed_pass.py, landed under feministic-baboonish-snake as 7b773a77f5e (Gerrit 3513).
